exceptions.description: The submitted file type is outside the agreed intake perimeter.
exceptions.recommended_action: Reject the document with an explicit operator message and capture the discard reason.

exceptions.description: The source document is too degraded to produce reliable review assets.
exceptions.recommended_action: Request a better source or route the case to assisted manual handling.

exceptions.description: The OCR engine failed to process the normalized assets.
exceptions.recommended_action: Retry the OCR run and escalate only after repeated failure.

exceptions.description: OCR completed but text coverage is too poor for reliable extraction.
exceptions.recommended_action: Send the document to manual review and capture the quality issue.

exceptions.description: One or more required metadata fields could not be produced at extraction time.
exceptions.recommended_action: Route the case to review with unresolved field codes and evidence pointers.

exceptions.description: The reviewer cannot validate the document because a policy or completeness rule is violated.
exceptions.recommended_action: Escalate to supervisor or discard under the documented governance rule.

exceptions.description: Protocol registration could not be completed because the downstream system is unavailable.
exceptions.recommended_action: Retry the integration and hold publication until the authoritative reference is returned.

exceptions.description: Fascicle assignment was rejected because the target classification or office context is invalid.
exceptions.recommended_action: Return the case to the competent office or correct the classification input.

exceptions.description: The downstream authoritative publication or export step failed.
exceptions.recommended_action: Retry publication with idempotent delivery and preserve the failed receipt.

exceptions.description: The preservation transfer did not complete successfully.
exceptions.recommended_action: Hold archival completion, preserve the transfer evidence, and escalate to records-management support.

exceptions.description: A discard action was attempted without the required authority or evidence.
exceptions.recommended_action: Block the discard, open an incident, and preserve the attempted action in the audit trail.
